summary: Wrote plain-English overlay pages for all six machine-readable research records currently in the repository: both theory records and all four experiment records under research/. Each overlay states the question, the candidate and comparator, what the frozen gate would have counted as a pass, and — for the four experiments with recorded results — what actually happened, preserving the exact run-validity and scientific-outcome wording (two inconclusive, two fail, one of them explicitly a narrow fail with positive signal) and rendering the result records via the ResultSummary component. No research record, protocol, or source file was modified.
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
